headline: Nigerian Naira Weakens as Foreign Exchange Reserves and Turnover Fall
summary: The naira closed weaker at N1,350.45 per dollar on 5 November 2026, down from N1,346.01 previously, while interbank turnover dropped to about $82 million according to Central Bank of Nigeria data.
why: Exchange rate movements and foreign exchange turnover reflect liquidity conditions in emerging market currency trading and impact import costs.

impacts.name: USD/NGN
impacts.why: The official central bank data showed the naira closing weaker against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Central Bank of Nigeria data showed lower interbank foreign exchange turnover and a weaker closing rate for the naira against the dollar.
